hero.description: In Malaysia, electoral boundary drawing exercises are conducted separately for 3 units, namely Peninsular Malaysia, Sabah, and Sarawak respectively. This page allows you to explore exactly what changes were made to your voting area.

where_seats_new: Where did the new boundaries come from?
where_seats_old: Where did the old boundaries go to?

map_explorer.title: Explore the map before and after redelineation

unchanged.title: Unchanged
unchanged.description: A seat is 'Unchanged' if there was no meaningful change in boundaries, even if the seat was renamed.

changed.title: Changed
changed.description: A seat is 'Changed' if there was a meaningful change in boundaries, regardless of whether or not it was renamed.

new.title: New
new.description: A seat is 'New' if it was created from splitting an old seat, or merging two or more old seats together.

abolished.title: Abolished
abolished.description: A seat is 'Abolished' if there is no new seat where a majority of its territory overlaps with the old seat.

constituency_redistribution: Explore the impact of redelineation on a specific seat

table.perc_from_parent: What % comes from this old seat?
table.perc_to_child: What % went to this new seat?
